name: PTW – Safety & Sustainability Intelligence
description: Safety + Carbon intelligence dashboard for Permit-to-Work. Includes filters, KPIs, trends, and graph relationships.

widgets.title: Permits
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN count(p) AS value;

widgets.title: Live
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE p.status='Live' AND ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN count(p) AS value;

widgets.title: High Risk
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE p.risk_band='High' AND ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN count(p) AS value;

widgets.title: Over Budget
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE p.over_budget=true AND ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN count(p) AS value;

widgets.title: Status distribution
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN p.status AS label, count(*) AS value ORDER BY value DESC;

widgets.title: Risk distribution
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN p.risk_band AS category, count(*) AS value ORDER BY value DESC;

widgets.title: Daily carbon (kg CO₂e)
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) WHERE p.start_at IS NOT NULL AND ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) WITH date(p.start_at) AS d, sum(coalesce(p.ptw_kg_co2e,0.0)) AS total RETURN d AS x, total AS y ORDER BY x;

widgets.title: Carbon by location (Top 10)
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) WITH l.name AS category, sum(coalesce(p.ptw_kg_co2e,0.0)) AS value RETURN category, value ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

widgets.title: Carbon by contractor (Top 10)
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit)-[:BY_CONTRACTOR]->(c:Contractor) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) WITH c.name AS category, sum(coalesce(p.ptw_kg_co2e,0.0)) AS value RETURN category, value ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

widgets.title: Clashes graph (filtered)
widgets.query: MATCH (a:Permit)-[r:CLASHES_WITH]->(b:Permit) WHERE ($permit_no IS NULL OR a.permit_no = $permit_no OR b.permit_no = $permit_no) AND ($status = [] OR a.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR a.risk_band IN $risk) RETURN a, r, b LIMIT 300;

widgets.title: Permits table
widgets.query: MATCH (p:Permit) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:BY_CONTRACTOR]->(c:Contractor) WHERE ($status = [] OR p.status IN $status) AND ($risk = [] OR p.risk_band IN $risk) AND ($over_budget IS NULL OR p.over_budget = $over_budget) AND ($level2 IS NULL OR p.level2_detected = $level2) AND ($permit_no IS NULL OR p.permit_no = $permit_no) AND ($from IS NULL OR p.start_at >= datetime($from)) AND ($to IS NULL OR p.start_at < datetime($to)) RETURN p.permit_no AS permit_no, p.status AS status, p.risk_band AS risk_band, p.risk_score AS risk_score, p.level2_detected AS level2, p.over_budget AS over_budget, p.ptw_kg_co2e AS kg_co2e, p.cis AS cis, l.name AS location, c.name AS contractor, p.start_at AS start_at ORDER BY p.risk_score DESC, kg_co2e DESC LIMIT 500;
